{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness Mobile 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的原生移动端客户端。它通过 dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway 与 Harness 建立 WebSocket 连接，将工作区、会话、实时回复和 Agent 执行轨迹带到 iPhone，同时延续 DeepSeek WebUI 克制、清晰的视觉语言","id":"gh:1337347330","install_available":false,"language":"Kotlin","name":"dsh-mobile","slug":"Clarklevis1995/dsh-mobile","topics":["android","android-app","android-application","android-development","coding-agent","deepseek","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","ios","ios-app","ios-swift","kmp","kotlin-multiplatform","kotlin-multiplatform-mobile","ui-design"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness Mobile 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的原生移动端客户端。它通过 dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway 与 Harness 建立 "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"WebSocket 连接，将工作区、会话、实时回复和 Agent 执行轨迹带到 iPhone，同时延续 DeepSeek WebUI 克制、清晰的视觉语言"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português (Brasil)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# Whaleness — A Third-Party Mobile Client for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Native Android and iOS apps with core business logic shared through Kotlin Multiplatform.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Connect to DeepSeek Harness through Mobile Gateway to access workspaces, live conversations, Agent t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"races, plugins, scheduled tasks, and files from your phone, tablet, or foldable."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Website: Whaleness"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Whaleness is an independently developed third-party native mobile client for DeepSeek Harness. Both "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Android and iOS apps use Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- `shared` is the source of truth for shared business state, including protocol handling, state mach"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ines, reducers, projections, and synchronization.
- `androidApp` implements the Android app with Kot"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"lin, Jetpack Compose, and OkHttp.
- `DeepSeekHarnessMobile` builds the iOS interface with SwiftUI/UI"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"Kit and accesses shared logic through a Kotlin/Native framework."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Both apps connect to Harness over WebSocket through `dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway`. With the gateway’s "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"experimental WebRTC option enabled, paired clients prefer two native RTC data channels and explicitl"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"y fall back to WebSocket when negotiation fails. Settings shows the selected connection method. See "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"App integration and validation. Networking, secure storage, files, images, lifecycle handling, and b"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ackground execution use native platform APIs. Business rules are consolidated in `shared/commonMain`"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" wherever practical."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Downloads and Prerequisites"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **iOS**: Join the TestFlight beta. Supports iPhone and iPad running iOS / iPadOS 16.1 or later.
- "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"**Android**: Download an APK from GitHub Releases. Requires Android 7.0 (API 24) or later. In-app up"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"date checks prefer the accelerated download source and verify downloaded packages.
- **Desktop host*"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"*: Run DeepSeek Harness with **`dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway` 0.11.2 or later** installed and enabled. "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"`AppRelease/release-info.json` defines the required minimum version.
- **Voice input**: Enable the o"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"fficial Voice Input plugin in the desktop host's Plugins section, finish model download and initiali"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"zation, and grant microphone access on the mobile device."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Beta Community"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Join the Whaleness beta WeChat group 2 to share feedback, discuss your experience, and get support. "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"Scan with WeChat, or save the image and recognize it in WeChat."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> Updated on November 5, 2026. The original image states that the code is valid before November 12, "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"2026. If it has expired, check the product page for the latest group QR code."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Platform Status"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Platform / module | Status | Main components |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| KMP `shared` | Used by Android and iOS | Gateway protocol, stores/reducers, conversation and trace"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" projections, history synchronization, questions/approvals, session control, workspace file state, a"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"nd code preview support |
| Android | Native client available | Jetpack Compose, OkHttp WebSocket, D"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ataStore for non-sensitive settings, Keystore for credentials, CameraX/ML Kit QR scanning, foregroun"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"d service, attachment cache, file downloads, and previews |
| iOS | Native client available | SwiftU"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"I/UIKit, URLSession WebSocket, UserDefaults for non-sensitive settings, Keychain for credentials, QR"},{"id":"p18s7","text":" pairing, background execution, attachments, and workspace files |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> Android and iOS each have their own native UI and platform integrations. Features and interactions"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" are being aligned, while some system-level behavior differs between platforms."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Recent additions"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Agent teams**: View members, switch between the lead and member conversations, and inspect share"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"d tasks with status, ownership, and links to the relevant conversation.
- **File uploads**: Choose f"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"iles in the conversation, follow upload progress, remove attachments, or retry a failed upload. Sent"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" and generated files appear as cards that can be opened or downloaded.
- **Text selection and tables"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"**: Open a dedicated text-selection screen to select, select all, and copy without losing your conve"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"rsation position. Read Markdown tables full screen, rotate them, copy them, or export CSV; narrow ta"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"bles fit the available width and wide tables scroll horizontally.
- **Chat history and storage**: Ca"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"che conversations locally and search common conversations offline. Review storage used by images, ch"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"at history, file previews, and temporary files, and clear local caches by category. Restore history "},{"id":"p22s10","text":"when returning to a session and load earlier messages progressively.
- **iPhone Duo and wide screens"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"**: Adapt home-screen columns, safe areas, the composer, and the animated background to folding, unf"},{"id":"p22s12","text":"olding, and rotation. Wide conversations provide a persistent sidebar with sessions grouped by works"},{"id":"p22s13","text":"pace; navigation and task controls adapt to the available space.
- **iOS 16.1 compatibility**: The d"},{"id":"p22s14","text":"eployment target is now iOS 16.1, with compatible interfaces for older systems. System-dependent eff"},{"id":"p22s15","text":"ects and features remain subject to the iOS version and device capabilities.
- **Refined native inte"},{"id":"p22s16","text":"ractions**: Improve Android frosted-glass menus, session renaming, and swipe navigation, plus iOS ba"},{"id":"p22s17","text":"ckground reconnection, file browsing, and image compatibility."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Conversations and Agent Execution"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Live native conversations**: Stream WebSocket events with Markdown, code, reasoning, tool calls,"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" tool results, and image attachments.
- **Voice and text input**: Switch to a dedicated hold-to-talk"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" area, release to transcribe into an editable draft, or slide up to cancel. Transcription uses the v"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"oice input capability on the host.
- **History, queues, and commands**: Merge paginated history with"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" the live tail and deduplicate events. View and edit queued messages, and use slash commands provide"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"d by the host. On iOS, loading older messages preserves the current reading position.
- **Agent trac"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"es**: Inspect User, Assistant, and Tool events, including arguments, results, schemas, token usage, "},{"id":"p24s8","text":"and timing.
